            后台管理框架存活率大调查（2026版）

                    阅读5分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-f67534b4=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-f67534b4=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">前言</h2>
<p>在 AI 乱杀的当下，后台管理开源框架的斩杀线也在逐部拉高。曾经我们推荐、高star的这些开源项目，还有几个存活，或者是苟延残喘，不妨来做一次大筛查。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>本次筛查截止至2026/10/08，所有数据统计、截图和个人点评，也均代表过往，不代表未来</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-1"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vben Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/436cb79a324e4bad8c8468d469d584ab~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=6usrXUSwq8NqKjpYfMfU1lUpZ5U%3D" alt="www.vben.pro_.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：33.6k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/10/07</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/05/21（v5.7.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">点评</h3>
<p>作为管理后台框架界的大哥，凭借着设计美观和高活跃的维护，在社区内一直是大部分开发者的首选。但也一直被许多开发者诟病过度封装，框架太重。</p>
<p>另外近期因该 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin%2Fissues%2F8032" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin/issues/8032" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">issue</a> 也暴露出管理上的缺陷，并且自从这个 issue 发布后，发版也停滞了。虽然 commit 几乎每日都有提交，但最新版本距今已经快有小半年没发布了，看来 Vben 团队也在避免再次引起负面的舆论。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpure-admin%2Fvue-pure-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/pure-admin/vue-pure-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vue Pure Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2d9f6f7e51f64b7d939195eb499e70d1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=RbUk0gz%2FF4YdXz4bjuItwHVJMHQ%3D" alt="pure-admin.github.io_vue-pure-admin_.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：20.7k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/08/24</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/04/07（v7.0.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">点评</h3>
<p>仅次于 Vben 的另一个老牌框架，基于 element-plus 。整体风格中规中矩，也符合作者自己的开发理念“稳定中求创新”。</p>
<p>该框架作者我在24年的时候有接触过，那会他就已经全职维护该项目了。但目前在官方的<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fpure-admin.cn%2Fpages%2Fnews%2F" target="_blank" title="https://pure-admin.cn/pages/news/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">最新通知</a>里得知，受到 AI 的冲击，几款基于 Pure Admin 的衍生产品已经暂停维护，不过从主仓库来的情况来看，似乎也已经处于半维护的状态了。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-5"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsoybeanjs%2Fsoybean-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Soybean Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8499d9d582ec4ddfb538b7b24b4256ff~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=7CAT5omcnIHx4SbSzieMGoQcOI8%3D" alt="soybeanjs.cn_home.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：15.1k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/10/06</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/05/13（v2.2.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">点评</h3>
<p>NaiveUI 社区的优秀框架，并且活跃维护，虽然最新版本距今也有小半年没发布了，但通过该 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsoybeanjs%2Fsoybean-admin%2Fissues%2F941" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/issues/941" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">issue</a> 得知作者正在为 3.0 版本做准备中。</p>
<p>另外作者也有提供 AntDesign 和 ElementPlus 的版本，但均为二等公民，更新维护的频率远不如主项目。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-7"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fun-pany%2Fv3-admin-vite" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/un-pany/v3-admin-vite" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">V3 Admin Vite</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b59573db0eab4af189ab4357ef4cb13c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=KiIYQ8wIGLaxEuZlVe8WWx6LJ70%3D" alt="un-pany.github.io_v3-admin-vite_.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：7.9k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/07/11</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/07/10（v5.2.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">点评</h3>
<p>主打轻量化的 ElementPlus 框架，轻量到文档就只有一篇<a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7445151895121543209" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7445151895121543209">博客文章</a>就能介绍完。</p>
<p>也是目前少数轻量化框架中还在维护的，风格也中规中矩，适用于小微项目。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-9"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fjekip%2Fnaive-ui-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/jekip/naive-ui-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Naive UI Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/403989fc3af0473ebe46efe0db1c784a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=nO1XOvRCQKLTsKBejW1YzpybVMQ%3D" alt="gratis.naiveadmin.com_dashboard_console.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：5.9k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/01/19</li>
<li>最近发版：2024/09/14（v2.0.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">点评</h3>
<p>早期专注于 NaiveUI 社区的框架，但自从商业化后，开源版本几乎停滞。虽然 commit 偶然有提交，但最新版本依旧停在24年。</p>
<p>另外商业化的定价也是几个有做商业化框架里价格<strong>最贵</strong>的。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-11"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FDaymychen%2Fart-design-pro" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/Daymychen/art-design-pro" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Art Design Pro</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3cc0c4b2eb964fddb30d0959c5ad2dac~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=N3RfDtcBUJDQIJ2j%2BXa8O4X0wIs%3D" alt="www.artd.pro_.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：5.9k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/06/01</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/05/15（v3.0.2）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">点评</h3>
<p>凭借对 element-plus UI 的美化，且框架整体和 UI 保持风格一致，成为近两年脱颖而出的后起之秀。</p>
<p>但推出商业化后，框架最近半年的维护频率几乎为0，可以初步判定开源版已经断更。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-13"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffantastic-admin%2Fbasic" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fantastic-admin/basic" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Fantastic Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/831f618bf28d4930963ce228c71fba9a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=J5W1MHB3aowu4xak5s%2BuueslQUs%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：3.4k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/09/29</li>
<li>最近发版：2026/08/30（v6.4.0）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">点评</h3>
<p>和 Vben 一样基于 shadcn-vue 开发的框架，提供了大量内置 UI 组件，并且也支持搭配 AntDesign / ElementPlus / NaiveUI / 等多个三方组件库使用。</p>
<p>优点在于没有 Vben 那样笨重，monorepo 的分包也极为克制，并且是首个框架内提供了 skills ，对 AI 开发友好。</p>
<p>整体设计风格在线，商业化的定价也是几个有做商业化框架里价格<strong>最便宜</strong>的。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-15"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhangjob%2Fvue-bag-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/hangjob/vue-bag-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vue Bag Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/14378442859147a4b126568adeb7653c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=F%2FBPq0Z7hu04jY3I%2FmbIsbgs2iE%3D" alt="hangjob.github.io_vue-bag-admin_.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：1.3k</li>
<li>最近提交：2026/09/01</li>
<li>最近发版：无正式发布记录</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">点评</h3>
<p>作者提出了一套可拆包发布插件化的思想，但似乎由于本身体量较小，并没有造成太大水花。</p>
<p>并且由于没有版本化的概念，想要使用一个较为稳定的版本，只能拉取仓库最新代码。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-17"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fchansee97%2Fnova-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/chansee97/nova-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Nova Admin</a></h2>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ca99ac8805594a559ac89615a81806a8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSG9vcmF5:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794466418&amp;x-signature=SkEJ%2FwhbsmtNt5RR%2FUm6MkKxj0Q%3D" alt="nova-admin.pages.dev_dashboard_workbench.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>star数：1.2k</li>
<li>最近提交：2025/10/30</li>
<li>最近发版：2025/08/02（v0.9.18）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">点评</h3>
<p>主打轻量化的 NaiveUI 框架，没有太多复杂的功能，适合小微项目使用。</p>
<p>但或许也是因为轻量化，导致该项目已经断更了。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-19">总结</h2>
<p>可以看到，已经有不少框架已经停止维护，或者进入半维护的状态。说明 AI 对管理系统框架的冲击还是不小的，尤其是一些轻量化的框架模板，使用开源项目或者让AI直接临时搭建一个，在整体耗时上或许并不会相差太多。</p>
<p>而本身体量较大，功能特性繁多，像 Vben 这样贡献者众多的项目，已经度过了做加法的阶段，更考验管理者的管理能力。</p>
<p>而像 Art Design Pro 和 Fantastic Admin 这类作者单人维护的项目，除了作者审美品味外，也在考验项目是否能长期维护，商业化就是必经的道路。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-20">省流版</h2>
<p>积极维护的：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vben Admin</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsoybeanjs%2Fsoybean-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Soybean Admin</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fun-pany%2Fv3-admin-vite" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/un-pany/v3-admin-vite" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">V3 Admin Vite</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffantastic-admin%2Fbasic" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fantastic-admin/basic" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Fantastic Admin</a></p>
<p>审美在线的：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vben Admin</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsoybeanjs%2Fsoybean-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Soybean Admin</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FDaymychen%2Fart-design-pro" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/Daymychen/art-design-pro" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Art Design Pro</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffantastic-admin%2Fbasic" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fantastic-admin/basic" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Fantastic Admin</a></p>
<p>基于 shadcn-vue 并且适配三方组件库的：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vben Admin</a> / <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffantastic-admin%2Fbasic" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/fantastic-admin/basic" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Fantastic Admin</a></p>

<p>开源版里功能最完善的：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvbenjs%2Fvue-vben-admin" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/vbenjs/vue-vben-admin" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Vben Admin</a></p>
